scope: 12 exact CPU cooler identities; 7 air / 5 AIO; narrow manufacturer facts only

verification.method: Codex inspection of official product tables and the linked Corsair/ARCTIC manuals

noctuaD15G2.scope: Current standard brown model: supported sockets, included multi-socket kit, total dimensions and fans. HBC/LBC are distinct variants.

noctuaU12A.scope: Brown NH-U12A, current product specification and package contents. Not chromax.black or NH-U12S.

noctuaD15Black.scope: Current page explicitly lists 168 mm with fans and 160 mm without. This record does not inherit the commonly quoted historical 165 mm height or NH-D15 G2 specifications.

noctuaL9AM5.scope: AM5-specific low-profile model, AM5 mounting kit, total dimensions and fan. AM4 and NH-L9i are distinct products. Socket support is not thermal suitability.

thermalrightPS.scope: Non-ARGB Phantom Spirit 120 SE: supported sockets, heatsink dimensions and TL-C12B V2 fan size. Heatsink dimensions are not asserted to include an arbitrarily raised fan.

thermalrightPA.scope: Non-ARGB Peerless Assassin 120 SE: socket support, heatsink dimensions and TL-C12C fan size. Not PA120, SE ARGB or Mini.

thermalrightAX.scope: Exact non-ARGB model: socket list, heatsink dimensions and TL-C12C fan dimensions. The page also contains an ARGB connector row; lighting is deliberately not asserted.

arctic240.scope: Original non-RGB black Liquid Freezer III 240, exact part number: supported sockets, 277 × 120 × 38 mm radiator and two P12 fans. Not III Pro, RGB or B-stock.

arctic360.scope: Original non-RGB black Liquid Freezer III 360, exact part number: supported sockets, 398 × 120 × 38 mm radiator and three P12 fans. A separate older 2D drawing lists 397 mm; this record preserves the current product table basis.

arctic420.scope: Original non-RGB black Liquid Freezer III 420, exact part number: supported sockets, 458 × 138 × 38 mm radiator and three P14 fans. Nominal 420 mm is not physical length.

arcticManual.scope: Exact 240 installation paths for AMD AM5/AM4 and Intel LGA1851/1700, contact-frame procedure, cables and packaging. Not a machine-verified installation or a substitute for the manual.

arcticBoardFit.model: Liquid Freezer III motherboard compatibility list
arcticBoardFit.scope: Manufacturer documents exact-board pump/M.2-heatsink interference and unsupported boards. No universal motherboard compatibility is inferred from socket support.

corsair240.scope: Exact non-ARGB black 240 model: four supported sockets, nominal radiator size and tube length. Generic Product Height/Width values are not treated as verified radiator thickness.

corsair360.scope: Exact non-ARGB black 360 model: four supported sockets, nominal radiator size and tube length. Product length is not converted into a full radiator-fit claim.

corsairManual.scope: Explicit included LGA1851/1700 and AM5/AM4 hardware; two RS fans for 240, three for 360. OEM AMD motherboard backplate and case layout must still be checked.

amd9800.scope: Processor-in-box thermal solution: not included. Manufacturer recommends liquid cooling; this does not establish that every AIO is suitable or an air cooler cannot work.

amd7800.scope: Processor-in-box thermal solution: not included. Manufacturer recommends liquid cooling; no measured cooler performance is inferred.

amd7600.scope: Exact boxed model lists AMD Wraith Stealth. Does not prove an OEM, tray or second-hand listing includes it or certify case fit.
